title: Recalculate discount when Opportunity amount changes
body: Replaces the flat LegacyDiscountCalc with tier-based DiscountService. Discount is recalculated in before update whenever Amount changes. Adds Discount_Percent__c and shows it on the layout.
acceptance_criteria: Discount_Percent__c is set from the Account tier (Gold 15, Silver 10, Bronze 5)
Works for Data Loader updates of 200 Opportunities
Sales users can see the discount on the Opportunity page
